title: The Fourteen Months in Which Sendy Wound Down
conflicts: Total funding $26.5m disclosed (TechCrunch) vs $29m (Business Daily, HapaKenya): both given. October 2022 cut 20% (Alloys via HapaKenya) vs 54 employees (TechCrunch) vs 10% (a TechMoran headline link): story uses Alloys's 20%. Founding 2015 (TechCrunch, TechMoran) vs 2014 (Daba): 2015 used. Failed round, valuations and salary shortfall rest on TechCrunch's unnamed sources and are attributed to them.
notes: Slate founder 'Evans Ochieng' corrected to Evanson Biwott (TechCrunch, TechMoran). No founder account of the closure decision exists in loadable sources (TechCabal and Techpoint block the verifier), so the story uses only Alloys's public statements and states no feelings; causes are limited to the reported investor withdrawal and Alloys's own words. Stance affirms (Epictetus II.5, the sinking ship).
